subject: Implementation kickoff: model shortlist, context needs & sizing for Integrum Health
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kiran Patel <kiran.patel@integrumhealth.com>, Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@integrumhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Implementation kickoff: model shortlist, context needs & sizing for Integrum Health

Hi Kiran / Alex —

Great to be kicking this off. Per our discovery call, Integrum's first milestone is a secure Q4 pilot that surfaces clinical note summarization and patient-facing Q&A behind your VPC. To move into a scoped SOW we need to align on model candidates, context length needs, and a conservative token-volume forecast so SRE/finance can size Dedicated capacity.

Attached are two starter artifacts: a token-profile spreadsheet (integrum_token_profile_v1.xlsx) and an initial model-shortlist PDF (model_shortlist_notes_v0.3.pdf). Quick asks to help the team finalize sizing this week: 
- Confirm worst-case context window per request (notes + history + metadata). Examples: 2k, 8k, or 32k tokens?
- Expected peak concurrent users and average queries per user per day (rough ranges are fine).
- Any strict PII redaction or context truncation rules we should bake in (we can do prefix masking or client-side redaction).

Internal notes for the team: Marissa — you'll lead onboarding / mutual action plan. Vivek — please review the shortlist and propose latency-friendly variants (quant, caching) for the 8k/32k cases. Lauren — FYI on potential Dedicated sizing ask.

Proposed next step: 30m technical handoff Friday 08/06 at 10am PT. Kiran/Alex, does that work?

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0172

From: Kiran Patel <kiran.patel@integrumhealth.com>

Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation kickoff: model shortlist, context needs & sizing for Integrum Health

Jordan — thanks and appreciate the materials. Friday at 10am PT works for Alex and me. Quick answers to your asks to help prep: 
- Context window: most clinical notes we want to summarize are 4–6 pages of free text; estimating ~6,000–10,000 tokens for a full note including structured metadata. For Q&A use-cases, we expect shorter contexts (1k–2k).
- Traffic profile: pilot target ~200 clinicians with 20–30 peak concurrent during morning rounds; average queries per clinician per day ~15–25. Production could grow 5–10x after successful pilot.
- PII: we need to keep all PHI in-context for accurate summarization inside our VPC; we cannot send raw PHI to hosted multi-tenant endpoints. We will require Private deployment or Dedicated with VPC peering.

Also attaching a sample redacted note for context (we'll send via secure share).

—Kiran
Director, Clinical Informatics
Integrum Health

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Kiran Patel <kiran.patel@integrumhealth.com>, Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@integrumhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation kickoff: model shortlist, context needs & sizing for Integrum Health

Thanks for the details, Kiran. Quick technical read on candidate models and how they'd map to the two primary workloads (summarization ~8k–10k tokens, Q&A ~1k–2k):

Candidate shortlist (initial):
- Redwood-13B-8k (quantized float16/INT8): strong latency at 8k, good summarization quality when paired with distillation prompts. Requires ~40–60 GB GPU memory for Dedicated with 2–3x headroom for batching.
- Llama2-13B-32k-Chat (8k–32k variant): better at longer coherence; if you want full-note (10k+) with source citations, consider 32k variant. Memory profile ~60–80 GB; higher token-costs per request.
- MPT-30B-Chat-32k (quant-friendly): strong for long-context summarization with calibrated decoding controls; favors throughput for batch summarizations.
- Smaller 7B-class for Q&A microservices (lower latency, cheaper): good for sub-2k queries, can act as fallback for cost-sensitive flows.

Sizing & cost heuristics (conservative pilot projection):
- Pilot traffic: 200 clinicians, 25 queries/day = 5k requests/day. Peak concurrency: 30 concurrent. If ~40% of requests are summarization averaging 7k tokens in + 600 tokens out, and 60% Q&A averaging 800 tokens in + 120 tokens out, token mix looks like: ~ (0.4 * 5600* + 0.6 * 920) ~ rough per-request tokens; see spreadsheet for precise calc.
- Rough token volume: 5k req/day * avg 3,000 tokens/req = 15M tokens/day (pilot). Production x10 => 150M tokens/day.
- Latency target: <500ms token emit for Q&A; <1.5s for streaming summarization first-chunk on Dedicated. To hit this we recommend: 
  * Dedicated capacity with 2 pool sizes: low-latency small-node pool (for 7B fallback & Q&A) and high-memory nodes for 13B/30B summarization workloads.
  * Prefix/KV caching for repeated clinician-history prefixes (can reduce effective compute by ~20–35% depending on overlap).
  * Batching windows tuned to 30–50ms for non-interactive summarization to improve throughput during morning rounds bursts.

Operational notes:
- Because PHI must stay in your VPC, we should scope for Redwood Private or Dedicated with VPC peering. Private gives a faster compliance path.
- If Integrum wants to keep costs down during pilot, use hybrid routing: Q&A -> 7B dedicated pool; Summaries -> 13B-8k dedicated nodes with optional off-peak batched jobs on MPT-30B nodes.

I'll upload a quick sizing matrix to the shared drive before Friday.

—Vivek
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Kiran Patel <kiran.patel@integrumhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation kickoff: model shortlist, context needs & sizing for Integrum Health

Appreciate the thoroughness, team. A couple of operational asks so our finance and delivery teams can finish internal approvals: 
1) Please confirm the minimal Dedicated GPU footprint required for the pilot (VM count / GPU types) in the sizing matrix Vivek promised. We need a line-item estimate for monthly reserved cost vs. burst (on-demand) cost.
2) Legal procurement will need the scope (Private vs Dedicated), expected data flow diagram, and a high-level Mutual Action Plan. Marissa, can you draft MAP and include a timeline for pilot -> production gating criteria?
3) Jordan — can you capture a concise one-page summary for the exec team at Integrum that lists the recommended model variants, estimated pilot token/day, and decision points for scaling? That will speed sign-off.

I want to keep the Friday call to align technical owners only; we can have a separate commercial/finance touchpoint after we have the sizing.

Thanks —Lauren
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kiran Patel <kiran.patel@integrumhealth.com>, Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@integrumhealth.com>

Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation kickoff: model shortlist, context needs & sizing for Integrum Health

Kiran / Alex — thanks for the details and for confirming Friday. Quick summary + next steps before the call: 
- Recommended pilot path: Dedicated with VPC peering (Private if you prefer single-tenant control). Start with Redwood-13B-8k for summaries (quantized) + 7B dedicated pool for Q&A fallback.
- Pilot token estimate (conservative): ~15M tokens/day (5k req/day). Production scale estimate x10 = ~150M tokens/day.
- Deliverables before Friday call:
  1) Vivek: sizing matrix + minimal GPU footprint (upload to Drive)
  2) Marissa: draft MAP and SOW outline
  3) Jordan: one-page exec summary (I'll attach to the HubSpot deal)

Meeting link: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890 (Fri 08/06 10:00am PT) — invite on the calendar.

If anything changes on your side (e.g., pilot scope or PHI handling preferences), flag it here and we'll adapt the plan. Looking forward to Friday.

Best,

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0172
